name: What Comes Next
summary: On Zephras Isle, the High Order seeks your blessing before departing with its Kirin Tor allies. Their expedition depends on finding an arcane answer to the island’s instability.

sections.title: The Departure
sections.body: High Elder Shadowsong has blessed the expedition, and its preparations are ready. Ansirem has worked to establish skycutter travel between Dalaran and Zephras Isle. Now the vanguard is preparing to depart. Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are ready to leave the island.

faq.q: Who do I speak with before leaving Zephras Isle?
faq.answer: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are ready to leave Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Where is the High Order going?
faq.answer: The High Order is preparing an expedition, with skycutter transport linking Dalaran and Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Who is helping the High Order?
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor are helping the High Order. Ansirem has worked on skycutter transport between Dalaran and Zephras Isle.
The expedition hopes to find an arcane solution to bring stability to Zephras Isle.
Elaadrin says the cult has been defeated, and preparations for the expedition are complete.

attribution: In-game quest text: What Comes Next
